about.metaDescription: StriveFormats checks and fixes product CSVs for Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay and Amazon in your browser. What it does, what runs where, and how it's built.
about.title: About StriveFormats
about.intro: StriveFormats checks product CSV files before you import them into an online store, fixes the problems that are safe to fix, and points at the exact row and column of everything else. It runs in your browser, so your catalogue never leaves your computer.
why: Store importers are strict, and their error messages rarely say which row is wrong. A file that looks fine in a spreadsheet can fail because of a price written as “45,00”, a variant row that lost its handle, or a blank cell that would quietly erase data already in the store.
StriveFormats knows each platform's rules, applies the fixes that can't change what your data means, and leaves every decision that could to you, with an explanation and a link to a guide.

privacy.metaDescription: What StriveFormats stores, where, and why. Your CSV files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: StriveFormats processes CSV files in your browser. This page lists everything the site stores, where, and why.

sections.title: Your CSV files
paras: Files you open in the CSV Fixer, Inspector, Converter or Merger are read, checked and exported entirely in your browser. Their contents are never uploaded to our servers or shared with anyone.
Custom formats and workspaces you create are saved in your browser's local storage on that device.

sections.title: If you create an account
paras: We store your email address (for signing in), your plan and subscription status, and how many exports you have used this month. Accounts are provided by Supabase.

sections.title: Without an account
paras: Your free export count for the month is kept in your browser's local storage. It is not sent to us.

sections.title: Usage information
paras: We record anonymous usage events, such as which tool was opened or that a file was checked, together with a random identifier kept in your browser. These events never contain file contents.
The site may use Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics to count page views. Google Analytics sets cookies; Vercel Analytics does not.

sections.title: Email updates
paras: If you enter your email address in the “new formats and features” box, we store it to send occasional product updates. You can ask us to remove it at any time.

sections.title: Payments
paras: Payments are handled by Stripe. We never see or store your card details; we only receive your subscription or pass status from Stripe.

sections.title: Your choices
paras: You can clear the data saved in your browser at any time through your browser settings. To have your account or email address removed, email {email}.

sections.title: Contact
paras: Questions about this policy or your data? Email {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: StriveFormats is provided as-is without warranties. You are responsible for verifying the accuracy of your exports before importing into third-party services.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paras: Do not use StriveFormats to upload or process unlawful content. Do not attempt to disrupt the service or bypass usage limits.

sections.title: Subscriptions
paras: Subscription billing is managed through Stripe. You can cancel or manage your subscription through the billing portal.
The 24-hour pass is a one-time payment. It does not renew and is not a subscription.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paras: StriveFormats is not liable for losses related to data imports, business operations, or third-party platform issues.

sections.title: Contact
paras: Questions about these terms, billing or a pass? Email {email}.

howItWorks.metaTitle: How the CSV Fixer works, step by step
howItWorks.metaDescription: A visual walkthrough of fixing a product CSV for Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay or Amazon: choose the format, read the summary, fix what's left and download a file that imports.
howItWorks.title: From a messy export to a clean import
howItWorks.intro: This walkthrough follows a small Shopify product file from upload to download. Every other format works the same way.

steps.title: Choose the format and add your file
steps.desc: Start with the platform you're importing into, because each one has its own rules.
steps.alt: The format picker with Shopify selected, and an uploaded file showing its row and column count
notes: Pick the platform you're importing into. You can switch later and the file is checked again.
Drop in your CSV, choose it, or paste the text. If you don't have a file to hand, load the sample. Your file is read in your browser and never uploaded.

steps.title: Read the summary
steps.desc: The checks run as soon as the file opens, and the summary tells you whether it would import.
steps.alt: The summary panel with one blocking issue, the error and warning counts, the validation score and the export button
notes: Anything in this box would make the import fail. When it turns green, the file is ready.
The score is a quick health check. Errors count for more than warnings.
You can export at any time. If blocking issues are left, you're asked to confirm first.

steps.title: Fix what's left in the table
steps.desc: Problems the tool can't safely fix on its own are shown in place, so you can fix them in a few clicks.
steps.alt: The issues table with duplicate option values highlighted in red, a duplicate SKU in yellow, and the manual fixes list below
notes: Filter the table to errors, warnings or tips.
Red cells are errors and yellow cells are warnings. Click a cell to edit it, and the checks run again straight away.
Rows with issues are pinned under Manual fixes, each with an explanation of what's wrong and how to fix it.

steps.title: Check the automatic fixes and download
steps.desc: Open the list of automatic fixes to see every change that was made for you, then download the fixed file and import it into your platform.
steps.alt: The list of automatic fixes opened, showing normalized prices, true/false values, a URL handle and a status
notes: Prices, true/false values, handles and statuses are corrected without changing their meaning.
Download the fix log if you want a record of every change.
Files up to {rows} rows are always free to download.
